## Start here

Work through the seven numbered **topic modules** below. The 8th-edition textbook supports the statistical topics, with reproducible R analyses in Quarto.

**Start with [Module 1: Introduction to R](modules/01-introduction-to-r/index.qmd).** **Module 2** now begins with data types, measurement levels, and the descriptive statistics toolbox.

## Browse or download

Choose a format below, or start a module in the table. HTML and PDF contain the same course lessons; Quarto is their editable source. Reduced review materials and supplied book guides are supplementary.

## Course modules

| Module | Topic | Current material |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | [Introduction to R](modules/01-introduction-to-r/index.qmd) | Four lessons and practice |
| 2 | [Data and descriptive statistics](modules/02-data-and-descriptive-statistics/index.qmd) | Lessons 1–4, practice, and integrated review available |
| 3 | [Probability and distributions](modules/03-probability-and-distributions/index.qmd) | Five lessons, practice, and integrated review available |
| 4 | [Sampling and estimation](modules/04-sampling-and-estimation/index.qmd) | Four lessons, practice, and integrated review available |
| 5 | [Hypothesis testing and group comparisons](modules/05-hypothesis-testing/index.qmd) | Existing lesson; expansion planned |
| 6 | [Regression](modules/06-regression/index.qmd) | Planned |
| 7 | [Forecasting and applied analysis](modules/07-forecasting-and-applications/index.qmd) | Planned |

“Existing” means carried over from the previous course materials. “Planned” means a topic has been reserved in the course sequence, but its lessons have not yet been written.

## How each module works

Each module has a clear starting page, lessons, and student exercises where available. Instructor solutions and course-planning notes are stored separately. Readings and data sources appear inside the relevant lesson.

## Reference and supporting material

Our main statistical reference is *Essentials of Modern Business Statistics with Microsoft Excel*, **8th edition** (2020). We analyze data in **R** and write reproducible reports in **Quarto**.

[Data and course resources](resources/index.qmd) provides dataset downloads and provenance guidance.
